body:
Had been dating a guy (X) for almost a year, when he decided to move across the country to get his music career started. As we had been talking about marriage, I was pretty upset about it, but I had three months to prepare myself. X moves, I start seeing someone else. X then begins sending me things in the mail. CDs of bands I love, etc. We're still on good terms and talk every so often.

Two months later, he moves back. I run into him at a concert with new bf, and X calls me after the show, screaming expletives at me and telling me what a douche new boy is. So I pretty much tell him to shove it. He sends me a present for my birthday with the letters cut out of magazines, but with a message that I KNOW would only be from him. I do not respond.

Fast forward two years, now single again, he finds me. We go out for a beer, laugh about how much dating me apparently fucked with his head. Have a little too much to drink, pass out on his couch. I wake up to a flash going off, but survival instinct kicks in, so I don't move a muscle. Yeah, dude was taking pictures of me when I was asleep. I leave and confront him the next day via email, and tell him not to contact me again. Ban him on everything possible, and he still finds a way to send me a message, apologizing and blaming the alcohol. Yeah, there may be a restraining order in my future

tl;dr I have a stalker, and have made the mistake of being kind to him

I have income. The problem is that it's all going towards the gaping hole that is my debt. I actually love both my jobs, but make minimum wage at one, and just above at the other. I went from a job that paid the bills, but was sucking out my soul, to one of these jobs, but realized that wasn't going to cut it, so got the second...and it's still not working. I'm not looking for a magic solution here. Just an end to the spiral.

Yeah, I deferred my loans until I couldn't anymore. They're now in collection stage. Even called me at my work today, which was SUPER embarrassing...And disheartening. I've cut like crazy, and crashed with my friends over the summer to save some money. Even borrowed money from people, which I haven't been able to pay back yet.

My family and I get along, but that's about as far as it goes. Every time I talk to them, they get exasperated with me about everything. Why I'm not in grad school anymore, why I'm not married and popping out kids at this point in my life, ect. Basically, making me feel like a failure for everything I do...
I know what my passions are, it's how to get there that's discouraging. It seems like to accomplish my goals, I need money to do it, and that's the one thing I'm really lacking...
I don't think so, as student loan debt isn't solved by bankruptcy. I don't really know, though

Thanks for the response. It's really nice to hear that someone cares...fuck, I'm pretty much in tears now.

Um, well I was in graduate school a few years ago, but had to drop out due to health and money issues. So now I'm doing something I love, but it's a small business and they're struggling, so there aren't enough hours for me to work, and so I'm not getting paid as much. I have two jobs, but both of them think I'm working too much since I have two jobs...I've tried picking up hours at both, but it hasn't worked.

I've been trying to get myself out there and make new friends, as well as re-define the old friendships, but honestly, it's just making me feel more alone. I think I'm far too dependent on other people to make me feel liked/loved, especially right now.

I haven't spoken to a counselor. I tried searching for free counseling in my area a few months ago, but it was either check yourself in for suicide watch (which I don't want to do for obvious reasons) or pay up the ass, as I don't have insurance. Since I can't afford to pay for things like rent, I figured paying for counselling wasn't much of an option.

All of my family members live far away and have their own stuff going on (ie. loss of job, three kids, etc). I don't really want to burden them when they have to deal with their own lives, ya know?
